# Privacy notice: [FIELD OR CLUB NAME] site server

> **Template, not legal advice.** A draft by the Atalaia project for the
> field operator to fill in and adapt (text in [BRACKETS]). It must be
> reviewed by a lawyer who knows the GDPR and Portuguese Law 58/2019 before
> it is used, and before any hosted service goes live (decision P4-6).
> When you change it, raise the version the server records with each
> consent (`ATALAIA_PRIVACY_NOTICE_VERSION`).
>
> Version: [template-2026-10-19]

## 1. Who is responsible for your data

The data controller is **[OPERATOR'S LEGAL NAME]**, [ADDRESS], [TAX
NUMBER], which runs the games at [FIELD NAME]. Contact for anything about
your data: [EMAIL OR POSTAL ADDRESS].

[If a data protection officer has been appointed: Our data protection
officer is [NAME], [CONTACT].]

[If the site server is hosted by someone else: The server is hosted for
us by [HOSTING SERVICE], which processes the data only on our instructions
under a data processing agreement.]

## 2. What we keep, why, and on what basis

| Data | Why | Legal basis (GDPR Art. 6(1)) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Your account: username, email (optional), a hash of your password (never the password), whether two-factor login is on and its encrypted secret, when you registered and last logged in | To give you an account for the field's games | Your consent, given when you register (a) |
| Your roles at each field (player, marshal, game master, ...) | To let you do what your role allows | Your consent to the account (a); for staff roles, also our legitimate interest in running safe games (f) |
| Your logins: the address you connected from, your browser or app, the times | To keep your account secure and to detect misuse | Our legitimate interest in the security of the service (f) |
| A security log of actions on your account (logins, failed logins, changes, roles granted) with the address | Security and accountability | Our legitimate interest (f) |
| Records of your consents (what you agreed to, which version of this notice, when) | To show that you consented (GDPR Art. 7(1)) | Our legal obligation (c) |
| [When the field uses them:] game results and events linked to your player identity at the field | To run the games and keep their history | Our legitimate interest in running the games (f) |
| [When the field uses them:] chronograph readings of your replicas, signed by the marshal | The safety of players (replica power limits) | Our legitimate interest in safety (f) |
| [When the field uses it:] sharing your chronograph readings with other fields | So another field can see a replica's history | Your separate consent, per field, which you can withdraw (a) |
| [When the field uses it:] your federation number on a registration | When the field's rules for a game require it; it is never checked automatically | [To be confirmed by the legal review: the field's rules for that game] |
| [When the server has clubs:] the clubs you belong to (the club and your role in it) and the club invitations you received; the reports of club pages you made while logged in (never your address) | To show who belongs to a club and let its admins manage it; to moderate public club pages | Your consent to the account (a); for reports, our legitimate interest in moderating public pages (f) |

Your position on the field (GPS) **never reaches this server**: the field's
game controller uses it during a game only, and deletes it when the game
ends. What you type at the field's check-in (a name or nickname, a team
preference, the replicas you declare) stays on the field's controller, under
its own notice, and is deleted 30 days after the game.

We do not sell your data, use it for advertising or profiling, or make
automated decisions about you.

## 3. How long we keep it

| Data | Kept for |
| --- | --- |
| Account, roles and consent records | Until you erase your account |
| Logins | 30 days after they end or expire |
| Security log | 36 months |
| Chronograph readings | [365 days] |
| Game history | [24 months] |
| Registration data of people without an account | 30 days after the game |
| Club memberships | Until you leave the club or erase your account |
| Club invitations not accepted | 30 days |
| Reports of club pages | 12 months after they are decided |

The server deletes what is past these periods every day.

## 4. Your rights

You can, from your account on this server:

- **see** everything we hold about you (right of access, Art. 15);
- **download** it as a file of JSON documents (portability, Art. 20);
- **correct** your username or email (rectification, Art. 16);
- **erase** your account (erasure, Art. 17). Your account is anonymised: it
  can no longer be linked to you. Signed chronograph readings and game
  results stay, without your name, because other players' safety and games
  depend on them; the security log keeps what happened, without your
  addresses.

You can also ask us, at the contact in section 1, to restrict or object to
processing based on our legitimate interest (Art. 18 and 21), and withdraw
any consent at any time (Art. 7(3)); withdrawing does not affect what was
done before. Withdrawing your consent to the account means erasing it.

## 5. Complaints

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese supervisory
authority, the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD), Av. D. Carlos
I, 134, 1.º, 1200-651 Lisboa, www.cnpd.pt [check the address before use], or
with the authority of the EU country where you live or work.

## 6. Changes

If this notice changes, we tell you [HOW: by email, on the field's page]
before the change applies. The server records which version of the notice
each consent was given under.
